title: Predicting Central Serous Chorioretinopathy Recurrence Using Machine Learning
summary: Machine-learning models predict recurrence of central serous chorioretinopathy after laser treatment; the paper reports internal and external test-set accuracy and identifies clinical recurrence predictors. This is retrospective recurrence prediction, not evidence that model-guided care reduces recurrence. Internal and external test cohorts are described and Table 2 reports recurrence performance.
ai_technology: Supervised ML classifiers predict recurrence from clinical/ophthalmic variables.
